name: program_modulation
question: Is a NAMED, externally-defined gene program causally modulable by a SPECIFIC subset of perturbations? Program-level resolution, after single-perturbation resolution was shown dead.
why_this_after_four_nulls: Component 2 established that single-perturbation resolution fails (grounding rate p=0.902 vs shuffle; SAE features do not concentrate curated single-TF regulons above chance). Gate 0 DID find TRRUST enrichment at LINEAGE granularity (p=6.4e-5). Those bracket the method's resolution limit and predict this test.

non_circularity.program_definition: config/human_markers.json marker_sets, curated for Gate 0 BEFORE any Norman/CRISPRa work -- external to everything measured here.
non_circularity.feature_selection: Over CONTROL cells only (gene_association), so perturbation labels never touch selection. Verified by a shuffle-invariance unit test.
non_circularity.modulators_are_output: WHICH perturbations pass is a RESULT. No perturbation is named in advance. The previously-noticed CBL/UBASH3B/PTPN12 are NOT inputs; re-testing them directly would be circular and is not done.

test.step1: For each named program with >= 3 markers in the panel, select the eligible feature whose top-TOP_K control-cell gene-associations are most marker-enriched (hypergeometric).
test.step2: For every perturbation with >= MIN_CELLS cells: Mann-Whitney one-sided greater vs control on that feature; BH-FDR over PERTURBATIONS (not features); modulates iff q < ALPHA and AUC >= AUC_FLOOR.

nulls.label_shuffle: mode 'full': permute ALL labels including control (group membership independent of biology), recount, n_shuffle replicates. empirical_p = (1 + #{null >= real}) / (1 + n_shuffle). The legacy mode 'perturbed' (controls fixed) INFLATES this metric and is not the headline.
nulls.feature_background: Run the identical per-perturbation test on N_RANDOM_FEATURES other eligible features. Report the program's percentile. This directly answers the dominant-axis/promiscuity objection: if every feature has as many modulators, a large count means nothing.

positive_requires_all_three: empirical_p < 0.05 AND a high feature-background percentile (>= 90) AND a biologically coherent modulator list on inspection.
prestated_likely_negative: If the erythroid program simply IS K562's dominant axis, many perturbations will nudge it and the background percentile will be unremarkable. That is a REAL NEGATIVE and must be reported as one, never spun as 'many modulators found'.
seeds: 0,1,2; a modulator counts as stable if it appears in >= 2/3 seeds.
code: src/program_modulation.py; tests/test_program_modulation.py (oracle: specific world detected with shuffle p<0.05 and background pct>=90; DOMINANT-AXIS world correctly NOT flagged as a discovery; low-power programs flagged; feature selection verified label-free).
run: python3 src/program_modulation.py --adata norman_pert.h5ad --pert-col perturbation --control-value control --latent 2048 --k 32 --n-hvg 4000 --n-shuffle 50 --seed {0,1,2} --out causal_out/progmod_seed{S}.json
